name: Dr. Sampurna Murti
descriptor: Mumbai, Maharashtra · M.Sc, Ph.D. Biochemistry, The Institute of Science, (Bombay University), Mumbai, India
about: Dr. Murti, a highly qualified science expert with post-doctoral research experience from the University of California, Davis, U.S.A., and Hospital for Sick Children, Toronto, Canada, has taught Chemistry for over 10 years to 11th and 12th grade students in different schools across India. She has co-authored a book on Chemistry for 12th grade students, published by Cambridge University Press. She headed Pratham Books, set up by Pratham for publishing high-quality, low-cost books in multiple Indian languages for children. She has been associated with Pratham for over 6 years and has contributed significantly to the development of educational content.
contributions: Developing new content and writing scripts based on biochemical processes presented in simple and interesting formats
Editing and proofreading scripts, videos, posters, and content related to STEM subjects, Vocational skills, and Financial Literacy
Fact-checking, ensuring simplicity of language and presentation along with contextual relevance
Explaining complex scientific concepts in easily comprehensible styles
summary: Sampurna’s multilingual skills, experience in educational content development, and strong scientific background are aligned with our project goals. She has been instrumental in curating scientific videos and engaging with other science institutions to create resources for Pratham's Hybrid Learning program.

name: Jagadish Shrinivasavadhani
descriptor: Mysore, Karnataka · M.Tech in Computer Engineering from IIT Kharagpur
about: Jagdish Shrinivasavadhani has approximately 20 years of experience in the IT services industry. He was associated with various outreach activities while working in the corporate sector. He has been working towards the popularisation of science for several years. He has designed many activities that aim to link textbook science with everyday objects and processes. He has been associated with Pratham Mysore for the last 12 years and contributed immensely to the development of educational content.
contributions: Taught Mathematics at Arivu School for 8th standard students
Assisting Vision Empower Trust in reviews of Teacher Instruction Kits
Assisted in developing experiential learning packages for 8th and 9th grade
Managed ‘Learn, Out of the Box’ project for three years
Working with the Pratham Translation Network to provide content accuracy, review of the scripts/videos, and translation support (Kannada)
summary: Jagdish’s experience in Educational content development and his strong scientific background are aligned with our project’s goals. He has been instrumental in proofreading, translation, and editing, ensuring the accuracy, contextual relevance, and engagement of the resources.

name: Kedar Sohoni
about: Kedar Sohoni is a technology entrepreneur who has built research and analytics companies including Cross Tab. He is a B.Tech from IIT Bombay and a PGDM from IIM Lucknow.

Kedar Sohoni is the founder-director of Green Communities Foundation (GCF). Green Communities Foundation (GCF) is a not for profit company working in the waste management and sustainability space in urban and rural areas in and around Mumbai. Their mission is diversion of waste from landfills and to that end we offer end-to-end services to assist any waste generator into turning waste neutral. Since it commenced work in May 2017, GCF has worked with over 200 societies, commercial establishments, institutions and schools and saved over 5000 tonnes of MSW from going into landfills through a combination of segregation at source, composting and recycling.
His previous company Informate was acquired by Nielsen.
After a year of experimentation with waste management, he converted his society into a Waste Free Society.
He replicated this model across various societies in Mumbai after setting up GCF in 2017. His current focus area is Rural Waste Management.
GCF partnered with Pratham in 2022 to conduct the Plastic-STORI and develop educational resources on Plastic literacy.

name: Dr. Jyoti Shinde
descriptor: Family Physician and MD in Ayurveda with over 24 years of experience
about: Family Physician and MD in Ayurveda with over 24 years of experience, practicing independently in Pune.
Expertise in Public Health and Hygiene, Nutrition, First Aid, Lifestyle, Ayurveda, De-addiction, and Blood Donation.
Experience and knowledge strongly complement the objectives of this project.
Aligns well with our requirements for creating accurate and impactful health education resources.

name: Dr. Vandana Garg
about: An accomplished expert in Nutrition and Food Sciences, holds a Ph.D. in Food and Nutrition.
She is an Executive Committee member of the Indian Dietetic Association (Rajasthan chapter).
Her expertise and experience align well with the Health content planned for this year.
The expert is willing to collaborate with Pratham.

name: Vigyan Ashram
about: Vigyan Ashram is a pioneer in school based vocational education and rural technology development. Founded in 1983 in Pabal, Maharashtra, Vigyan Ashram empowers rural youth and entrepreneurs through hands-on learning (“Learning by Doing”), open-source digital fabrication, and sustainable community solutions.

name: Mudit Verma
expertise: STEM Curriculum Development and Teacher Training
about: A dynamic, performance-driven educator with over seven years in the education sector, specialising in designing and executing inquiry-based STEM modules. Experienced in researching and creating interactive K–12 math and science content for edtech platforms, developing assessment items aligned with NCERT, NEP 2020 and NCF 2023 frameworks, and using AI prompts and custom GPTs to streamline content workflows. Has built and implemented interactive STEM curricula for middle school, partnered with state education bodies on large-scale programmes, and equipped 1,000+ students and 500+ teachers with strong conceptual understanding and pedagogical practice. Also brings classroom teaching experience that lifted school pass rates, alongside work in theatre and experiential learning.

name: Beacon TV
about: Beacon Television is an award winning  production house established by Seema Muralidhara and H. B. Muralidhara. They are both journalists and television professionals trained from the FTII, Pune and Central Production Centre, New Delhi. Recipients of the National award for Popularising Science (2006) they have conceptualised, directed and produced several award winning TV series. They have been associated with Vigyan Prasar (DST), Zee TV, Star TV, Doordarshan, NCSM and several organisations like SEWA Federation, Vatsalya Foundation, FPAI, FOGSI, PSBT and TERI. They have been associated with Pratham Education Foundation for the production of several resources.

name: Abhivyakti
about: Abhivyakti provides services like Educational content creation, translations (English/ Hindi to Marathi), Marathi Proofreading/ review, lesson plan or on field sessions.

In the Health domain we provide services like Health Education Expert sessions, Counselling, Health content development (documents/ scripts), conducting workshops (gender awareness, menstrual hygiene management; expert talks on basic first aid for schools), and lectures/ live sessions of Yoga.
